results.name: Sweden
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 81.3 (registered override). The 1 September 2026 deportation rules move three subdimensions down (A5, E3, EQ1): formula 86.1 vs published formula 89.9 (-3.8). The numeric +4.8 against the override is an artifact, not an upgrade. Calibration referral: carrying the -8.6 override offset would give about 77.5.

results.name: Anthropic
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 59.1. Assessed by an Anthropic-built model, with the conflict disclosed. The Claude Max class action (filed 8 Sept, verified via Engadget after androidheadlines 403) is an allegation and moves nothing. The 1 Sept security follow-up (outbound blocked by default, ~150 engineers reassigned) meets the July watch trigger and raises AB4 only.

results.name: Ljubljana
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 81.4 (measured 81.1). The 9 Sept embassy protest targets national-government policy; the city is not mentioned, so no attribution. The Exemplary label is an untested placeholder, flagged for calibration.

results.name: Melbourne
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 77.4 (measured 75.9). The A$145M (4 Sept) is Commonwealth money for Victoria-wide projects with no City of Melbourne role, so it is not attributed. The city's own Strategy 2024-30 and 2026-27 outreach programme support existing values.

results.name: Guatemala
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 23.4 (measured 23.1). State response is mixed: a flat fuel price cap; clearance of 34 blockades only under a 6-hour Constitutional Court order (11 Sept); preventive army-police deployments; and an unproven narco-financing allegation by the president. UPI counts are unverified (403). Protest-rights watch set.

results.name: Lesotho
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 35.9 (measured 33.7, grid rounding). CORRECTION: the 2026-09-14 drop of the AGOA claim was wrong. It conflated the Feb 2026 extension (to end-2026) with the Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027, signed Wed 2 Sept 2026 (AGOA to 2028; Sunday Times + Lesotho Times). HR 6500 is supported by Lesotho Times text and a Sunday Times hyperlink, but not verified against congress.gov. AGOA is US conduct and is not scored.

results.name: Abbott Laboratories
results.key_finding: MEASURED-NOT-FILED: 50.0 (-7.8) reproduces the PENDING 2026-08-26 downgrade exactly, so no duplicate. The $384,999,040 Sturgis FCA/state settlement (14 Sept, DOJ tier 5) resolves allegations of testing avoidance and FDA non-disclosure with 'no determination of liability'. No new move; it corroborates the pending proposal.

results.name: Oracle Corporation
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 14.7. The 14 Sept layoff round (same-day 'Today is your last working day' email, lockouts, Oracle declined comment) landed in a $4.76B net-income quarter, so I3 moves 2->1. The 08-18 watch trigger (coercive release-or-forfeit terms) is unverified for this round, and the watch is carried. Rotation-state drift: rank 415 vs 413; stale index_registration_gap fields.

results.name: Bridgetown
results.key_finding: WITHHELD BAND CROSSING: measured 58.7 (Functional) vs 60.9 (Established), -2.2, entirely placeholder rounding. In-window conduct is positive: families rehoused within hours of the 3 Sept Chapman Lane fire, and a rebuild assessment on 8 Sept (conditional on land titles, watch). Flagged with the 60.9 cohort.

results.name: Kyiv
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 50.0 (measured 46.9). The 7-8 Sept strike (5 killed) is Russian conduct and not scored. Pre-window Reuters reporting (30 July) adds that only ~500 of 4,358 Kyiv shelter facilities are proper bomb shelters, plus an ombudsman audit touching 125 Kyiv sites. It is not Kyiv-disaggregated, so the watch is carried.

results.name: Lilongwe
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 21.9 (measured 21.3, 1.3 above Critical). The up-to-four-day tap outages (13 Sept) are reported against the Lilongwe Water Board, not the council, so attribution is partial. The reactive response matches existing anchors (2). Near-floor watch set.

results.name: Warsaw
results.key_finding: CONFIRM 59.4 (measured 58.1, grid rounding). The 7 Sept robot demonstration targeted the national digital ministry. It was launched by robot-rental firm Delta Robots, not a civic group as the scan said, and the city is not mentioned. No attribution to Warsaw.

results.name: Wellington
results.key_finding: PROPOSAL (downgrade 83.0 Exemplary to 71.3 Established, -11.7, band crossing). The statutory Crown Review (2 Sept, tier 5) found the Moa Point sewage failure came from longstanding governance, accountability and asset-management weaknesses, and that the city council, as owner, 'remained ultimately accountable'. The mayor's apology is credited. Any one of four moves (A5, AC4, S2, I4) alone crosses the band; AB4 alone does not.

corrections_to_prior_cycles.prior_file: research/scans/2026-09-14.json and its digest. NOT edited; append-only correction.
corrections_to_prior_cycles.correction: The 2026-09-14 scan dropped the Lesotho AGOA candidate as 'misdated and substantively wrong'. It reasoned that the reauthorisation was signed 3 February 2026, runs only to end-2026, and that the 2028 extension did not become law. The drop was wrong, because it conflated two laws. The Sunday Times (2026-09-04) confirms the February 2026 extension to end-2026. Separately, it reports that 'on Wednesday' (2 September 2026) the Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027 was signed, extending AGOA to 2028. Lesotho Times (2026-09-10) states HR 6500 was signed on 2 September 2026, extending AGOA to 31 December 2028. The bill number is not in the Sunday Times text, which has only a congress.gov house-bill/6500 hyperlink; treat it as reported, not verified against congress.gov.
